content.comment_body: Hello everyone, Using [product_name] Comfort [version_no], I have one diagram with [article_no] and another with [article_no]. Check this [company_name] FAQ: How to configure references between blocks in [product_name] [version_no]?

analysis.insight_summary: Users encountered inconsistencies in accessing the Reference button for arithmetic instructions when working with different hardware versions within the same software platform. The absence of the button in one hardware model led to confusion, highlighting possible gaps in functionality visibility depending on hardware specifics.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect uniform access to reference assignment options for arithmetic instructions across all hardware versions within the software.
